# Derive genetic correlations

Using an R implementation of LDScore regression (https://github.com/Ararder/ldsR) genetic correlations between the different cannabis use phenotypes were derived, as well as between 3 of those (ever use, all-frequency, and CUD) with a set of other traits.

```{r, eval = F}

library(ldsR)
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(readxl)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggnewscale)

# with external traits
	

get_rg <- function(filename, filename2) {

cat("analyzing", filename, "with", filename2)

	df <- fread(filename) %>% 
		drop_na() %>%
		munge()
		
	df2 <- fread(filename2) %>% 
		drop_na() %>%
		munge()
		
	res <- ldsc_rg(df, df2) 

	as_tibble(res)
}
		
files <- c("results/metal/MA_CANNABIS_EVR_250919.txt.gz",
			"results/gsem/ALL_FREQ_formatted.txt.gz",
			"~/sumstats/cannabis_use_disorder.sumstats.gz")
			
files2 <- fread("rg_traitselection.txt")
files2 <- paste0("~/sumstats/munged/", files2$Trait, ".sumstats.gz")
		
pairs <- crossing(file1 = files, file2 = files2)
rg <- map2(pairs$file1, pairs$file2, get_rg)

fwrite(rbindlist(rg), "results/gencor/gencor_external_traits.tsv")

# Among cannabis traits

files <- c("results/metal/MA_CANNABIS_EVR_250919.txt.gz",
			"results/metal/MA_FREQ_LIFETIME_250919.txt.gz",
			"results/metal/MA_FREQ_MAX_250919.txt.gz",
			"results/metal/MA_FREQ_PAST_250919.txt.gz",
			"results/gsem/ALL_FREQ_formatted.txt.gz",
			"results/gsem/ALL_CANNABIS_formatted.txt.gz",
			"~/sumstats/cannabis_use_disorder.sumstats.gz",
			)
			
pairs <- crossing(file1 = files, file2 = files2) %>%
	filter(file1 != file2)
	
unique_pairs <- pairs %>% filter(file1 < file2)	

rg <- map2(unique_pairs$file1, unique_pairs$file2, get_rg)

fwrite(rbindlist(rg), "results/gencor/gencor_internal_traits.tsv")

```

With the results, the dataframe is prepared for visualization. We correct for multiple testing using FDR within trait (so correcting for the number of outcome traits, not for the number of cannabis traits, because these are hardly independent).

```{r}

res <- fread("results/gencor/gencor_external_traits.tsv")
res <- res %>% 
  select(trait1, trait2, rg, rg_se, p) %>% 
  rename(p1 = trait1, p2 = trait2) %>%
  mutate(p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(rg/rg_se)))

labels <- read_xlsx("scripts/gencor/rg_traitselection.xlsx") %>%
  select(Trait, Category, filename)

gencor_forplot <- res %>% 
  mutate(Trait = ifelse(grepl("CANNABIS_EVR", p1), "Ever use", NA),
         Trait = ifelse(grepl("FREQ_MAX", p1), "Maximum frequency", Trait),
         Trait = ifelse(grepl("FREQ_LIFETIME", p1), "Lifetime frequency", Trait), 
         Trait = ifelse(grepl("FREQ_PAST", p1), "Recent frequency", Trait), 
         Trait = ifelse(grepl("FREQ_ALL", p1), "All-frequency", Trait),
         Trait = ifelse(grepl("MA_FREQ_CUD", p1), "Frequency/CUD", Trait),
         Trait = ifelse(grepl("CANN_FACTOR", p1), "All-cannabis", Trait),
         Trait = ifelse(grepl("candis", p1), "CUD", Trait)
         ) %>% 
  inner_join(labels, by = c("p2" = "filename"))

numberoftraits <- as.numeric(
  gencor_forplot %>% 
    select(p2) %>% 
    distinct() %>% 
    summarise(n=n())
)

gencor_forplot <- gencor_forplot %>% 
  group_by(p1) %>%
  mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p, "BH")) %>% 
  mutate(p_bonferroni = ifelse(p < (0.05/numberoftraits), "*", ""))  %>% 
  mutate(p_fdr_bin = ifelse(p_fdr < 0.05, "*", "")) %>% 
  ungroup()

# Use the same order as for both plots
order <- gencor_forplot %>%
  mutate(Trait.y = as_factor(Trait.y), levels = Trait.y) %>% 
  arrange(Category, rg) %>% 
  select(Trait.y)

gencor_forplot <- gencor_forplot %>%
  arrange(match(Trait.y, order$Trait.y)) %>% 
  mutate(Trait.y = as_factor(Trait.y), levels = Trait.y)

```

# Figure Sx: Gencor original traits

First, we create the supplemental figure for the genetic correlations between the original cannabis use traits (ever use, lifetime frequency, maximum frequency, and recent frequency) and the external traits.

```{r, fig.width = 10, fig.height=7}

plt1 <- ggplot(subset(gencor_forplot, (Category == "Cognition & SES" | Category == "Mental health" | Category == "Physical health") &
                        (Trait.x == "Ever use" | Trait.x == "Maximum frequency" | Trait.x == "Lifetime frequency" | Trait.x == "Recent frequency")), 
               aes(y=rg, x=Trait.y, color=Trait.x, shape = p_fdr_bin)) + 
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin=rg-1.96*rg_se, ymax=rg+1.96*rg_se), 
                  position = position_dodge(width = -0.65),
                  size = 0.25) +
  facet_grid(Category ~ ., scales = "free", space = "free_y") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(-1, 1)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, size = 0.15) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -1, size = 0.05) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, size = 0.05) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.title.y=element_blank()) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(colour = 'black',size=8),
        strip.background =element_rect(fill="white")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values =c("#388e3c", "#1976d2", "#ff8f00", "purple3"), 
                      name = "Cannabis trait") + 
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1,19)) +
  ylab("Genetic Correlation") +
  coord_flip() +
  guides(color = "none", shape = "none") 

plt2 <- ggplot(subset(gencor_forplot, (Category != "Cognition & SES" & Category != "Mental health" & Category != "Physical health") & 
                        (Trait.x == "Ever use" | Trait.x == "Maximum frequency" | Trait.x == "Lifetime frequency" | Trait.x == "Recent frequency")), 
               aes(y=rg, x=Trait.y, color=Trait.x, shape = p_fdr_bin)) + 
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin=rg-1.96*rg_se, ymax=rg+1.96*rg_se), 
                  position = position_dodge(width = -0.65),
                  size = 0.25) +
  facet_grid(Category ~ ., scales = "free", space = "free_y") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(-1, 1)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, size = 0.15) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -1, size = 0.05) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, size = 0.05) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.title.y=element_blank()) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(colour = 'black',size=8),
        strip.background =element_rect(fill="white")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values =c("#388e3c", "#1976d2", "#ff8f00", "purple3"),
                      name = "Cannabis trait") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1,19)) +
  ylab("Genetic Correlation") +
  coord_flip() +
  guides(shape = "none", color = "none")

# Extract legend

plt0 <- ggplot(subset(gencor_forplot, (Category != "Cognition & SES" & Category != "Mental health" & Category != "Physical health") & 
                        (Trait.x == "Ever use" | Trait.x == "Maximum frequency" | Trait.x == "Lifetime frequency" | Trait.x == "Recent frequency")), 
               aes(x=rg, y=Trait.y, color=Trait.x, shape = p_fdr_bin)) + 
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin=rg-1.96*rg_se, xmax=rg+1.96*rg_se), 
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.65),
                  size = 0.4) +
  scale_colour_manual(values =c("#388e3c", "#1976d2", "#ff8f00", "purple3"), 
                      name = "Cannabis trait") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1,19)) +
  theme_bw() +
  guides(shape = "none")

plt_legend <- get_legend(plt0)
plt_legend <- as_ggplot(plt_legend)



plt <- ggarrange(plt1, plt2, plt_legend,
                 nrow = 1,
          widths = c(1,1,0.4))

plt

ggsave("results/gencor/gencor_original_traits.svg", plt, height = 7, width = 10)
```

# Figure 4: ever use, all-frequency, and CUD

Next, we create a figure for the main text with the correlations between ever use, all-frequency, CUD, and the external traits.

``` {r, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 8}

lims <- c(-1, 1)
eps  <- diff(lims) * 0.02

gencor_forplot2 <- gencor_forplot %>% 
  mutate(
    Trait.x = as_factor(Trait.x),
    ymin_raw = rg - 1.96*rg_se,
    ymax_raw = rg + 1.96*rg_se,
    ymin_cap = pmax(ymin_raw, lims[1]),
    ymax_cap = pmin(ymax_raw, lims[2]),
    lo_clip  = ymin_raw < lims[1],
    hi_clip  = ymax_raw > lims[2]
  ) %>%
  group_by(Category, Trait.y) %>%
  mutate(max_rg_in_trait = max(rg, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Category) %>%
  mutate(Trait.y = fct_reorder(Trait.y, max_rg_in_trait, .desc = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(
    ypos = dense_rank(desc(Trait.y)),
    ypos = case_when(
      Trait.x == "Ever use"  ~ ypos + 0.27,
      Trait.x == "All-frequency" ~ ypos,
      Trait.x == "CUD"  ~ ypos - 0.27,
      TRUE ~ ypos
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

df3 <- subset(gencor_forplot2,
              Category %in% c("Cognition & SES","Mental health","Physical health") &
              Trait.x %in% c("Ever use","All-frequency","CUD"))

y_axis_map <- df3 %>%
  filter(Trait.x == "All-frequency") %>%
  distinct(Trait.y, ypos) %>%
  arrange(ypos)

plt3 <- ggplot(df3, aes(y = ypos, x = rg,
                        color = fct_rev(Trait.x), shape = p_fdr_bin)) +

  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = ymin_cap, xmax = ymax_cap), size = 0.3) +

  facet_grid(Category ~ ., scales = "free", space = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = lims,
                     breaks = seq(-1,1,0.25),
                     oob = scales::oob_squish) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = y_axis_map$ypos,
    labels = y_axis_map$Trait.y,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, size = 0.15) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -0.5, size = 0.05, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey") +
  geom_vline(xintercept =  0.5, size = 0.05, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#66a61e", "#7570b3", "#e7298a")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1,19)) +
  guides(shape="none", color="none") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(colour='black', size=8),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill="white"),
    
  ) +
  ylab("") +
  xlab("Genetic Correlation")



df4 <- subset(gencor_forplot2,
              !(Category %in% c("Cognition & SES","Mental health","Physical health")) &
              Trait.x %in% c("Ever use","All-frequency","CUD")) 

y_axis_map <- df4 %>%
  filter(Trait.x == "All-frequency") %>%
  distinct(Trait.y, ypos) %>%
  arrange(ypos)

plt4 <- ggplot(df4, aes(y = ypos, x = rg,
                        color = fct_rev(Trait.x), shape = p_fdr_bin)) +

  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = ymin_cap, xmax = ymax_cap), size = 0.3) +

  geom_segment(
    data = subset(df4, hi_clip),
    aes(y = ypos, yend = ypos, x = lims[2] - eps, xend = lims[2] + 0.05,
        color = fct_rev(Trait.x)),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(1.5, "mm"), type = "open")
  ) +

  facet_grid(Category ~ ., scales = "free", space = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(lims[1], lims[2] + 0.05),
                     breaks = seq(-1,1,0.25),
                     oob = scales::oob_squish) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = y_axis_map$ypos,
    labels = y_axis_map$Trait.y,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.03))
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, size = 0.15) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -0.5, size = 0.05, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey") +
  geom_vline(xintercept =  0.5, size = 0.05, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#66a61e", "#7570b3", "#e7298a")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1,19)) +
  guides(shape="none", color="none") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(colour='black', size=8),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill="white")
  ) +
  ylab("") +
  xlab("Genetic Correlation")


# Extract legend

plt0 <- ggplot(subset(gencor_forplot, (Category == "Cognition & SES" | Category == "Mental health" | Category == "Physical health") & 
                        (Trait.x == "Ever use" | Trait.x == "All-frequency" | Trait.x == "CUD")), 
               aes(x=rg, y=Trait.y, color=fct_rev(Trait.x), shape = p_fdr_bin)) + 
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin=rg-1.96*rg_se, xmax=rg+1.96*rg_se), 
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.65),
                  size = 0.4) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#66a61e", "#7570b3", "#e7298a"), 
                      name = "Cannabis trait") + 
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1,19)) +
  theme_bw() +
  guides(shape = "none")

plt_legend <- get_legend(plt0)
plt_legend <- as_ggplot(plt_legend)

plt <- ggarrange(plt3, plt4, plt_legend,
                 nrow = 1,
          widths = c(1,1,0.4))

plt

ggsave("results/gencor/gencor_com_frq_dis.svg", plt, height = 7, width = 11)
ggsave("results/gencor/gencor_com_frq_dis.jpeg", plt, height = 7, width = 11, dpi = 500)

``` 

# Supplemental table Sx: full genetic correlation results

Results are extracted for the supplemental materials. Shown here are the first 20 rows.

```{r}
cortable <- gencor_forplot %>% 
  select(Category, Trait.x, Trait.y, rg, rg_se, p, p_fdr) %>% 
  rename(Trait1 = Trait.x, Trait2 = Trait.y) %>% 
  mutate(Trait2 = as.character(Trait2)) %>%

kable(head(cortable, n=20))

fwrite(cortable, "results/gencor/gencor_cannabis.csv")
```

# Figure 2a: Between cannabis traits

We create a small heatmap for the cannabis traits among themselves.

```{r}

res <- fread("results/gencor/gencor_internal_traits.tsv") 

gencor_forplot <- res %>% 
  mutate(trait1 = ifelse(grepl("EVR", trait1), "Ever use", trait1),
         trait1 = ifelse(grepl("MAX", trait1), "Maximum frequency", trait1),
         trait1 = ifelse(grepl("LIFETIME", trait1), "Lifetime frequency", trait1), 
         trait1 = ifelse(grepl("PAST", trait1), "Recent frequency", trait1), 
         trait1 = ifelse(grepl("MA_FREQ_ALL", trait1), "All-frequency", trait1),
         trait1 = ifelse(grepl("FACTOR", trait1), "All-cannabis", trait1),
         trait1 = ifelse(grepl("dis", trait1), "CUD", trait1)) %>% 
  mutate(trait2 = ifelse(grepl("EVR", trait2), "Ever use", trait2),
         trait2 = ifelse(grepl("MAX", trait2), "Maximum frequency", trait2),
         trait2 = ifelse(grepl("LIFETIME", trait2), "Lifetime frequency", trait2), 
         trait2 = ifelse(grepl("PAST", trait2), "Recent frequency", trait2), 
         trait2 = ifelse(grepl("MA_FREQ_ALL", trait2), "All-frequency", trait2),
         trait2 = ifelse(grepl("FACTOR", trait2), "All-cannabis", trait2),
         trait2 = ifelse(grepl("dis", trait2), "CUD", trait2)) %>% 
  mutate(trait2 = gsub("^/sumstats/|\\.sumstats\\.gz$", "", trait2)) %>% 
  filter(trait1 != "All-cannabis" & trait2 != "All-cannabis")

# Make a square dataframe

df_sym <- gencor_forplot %>%
  mutate(pair_id = paste(pmin(trait1, trait2), pmax(trait1, trait2), sep = "_")) %>%
  distinct(pair_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(-pair_id) %>%
  bind_rows(
    gencor_forplot %>%
      rename(trait1 = trait2, trait2 = trait1)
  )

# Fill diagonal 
traits <- union(gencor_forplot$trait1, gencor_forplot$trait2)

df_diag <- tibble(
  trait1 = traits,
  trait2 = traits,
  rg = 1
)

df_full <- bind_rows(df_sym, df_diag)


# Only upper triangle for rg

trait_levels <- sort(unique(c(df_full$trait1, df_full$trait2)))

df_upper <- df_full %>%
  mutate(
    trait1 = factor(trait1, levels = trait_levels),
    trait2 = factor(trait2, levels = trait_levels)
  ) %>%
  filter(as.integer(trait1) >= as.integer(trait2))

gencor_upper <- gencor_forplot %>%
  mutate(
    trait1 = factor(trait1, levels = trait_levels),
    trait2 = factor(trait2, levels = trait_levels)
  ) %>%
  filter(as.integer(trait1)>= as.integer(trait2))

# Only lower triangle for se

traitcount <- 7

df_lower <- df_full %>%
  mutate(
    trait1 = factor(trait1, levels = trait_levels),
    trait2 = factor(trait2, levels = trait_levels)
  ) %>%
  filter(as.integer(trait1) < as.integer(trait2)) %>% 
  mutate(sig = ifelse(p < .05, "yes", "no"))

gencor_lower <- gencor_forplot %>%
  mutate(
    trait1 = factor(trait1, levels = trait_levels),
    trait2 = factor(trait2, levels = trait_levels)
  ) %>%
  filter(as.integer(trait1)< as.integer(trait2))

# Plot


plt <- ggplot(df_upper, aes(x = fct_rev(trait1), y = fct_rev(trait2), fill = rg)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2("Genetic correlation", low = "#CC6677", mid = "white", high = "chartreuse4", midpoint = 0) +
  geom_text(data = gencor_upper, aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", rg)), color = "black", size = 3) +
  coord_fixed(clip = "off") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 270, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0),
    legend.justification = "top",
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 40, b = 5, l = 5) 
  ) +
  ylab("") +
  xlab("") +
  ggtitle("Genetic correlation") +
  
  new_scale("fill") +
  
  geom_tile(data = df_lower, aes(fill = sig)) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("no" = "white", "yes" = "#faefb9")) +
  
  geom_text(data = df_lower, aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", rg_se)), color = "black", size = 3)  +
  
  annotate("text", label = 'atop(bold("SE (significance)"))', 
           angle = 270, 
           x = as.numeric(traitcount), 
           y = as.numeric(traitcount) / 2,
           parse = TRUE) 

plt

fwrite(gencor_forplot, "results/gencor/gencor_intern_cannabis.csv")

ggsave("results/gencor/rg_cannabis.svg", plt, width =4.5, height = 4.5)
ggsave("results/gencor/rg_cannabis.jpeg", plt, width =4.5, height = 4.5, dpi=500)

```
